name: tribunal-launch-gate
command:
set -eu; kujo --version > tribunal-workcell-proof.txt; ./bin/tribunal version >> tribunal-workcell-proof.txt; ./bin/tribunal doctor --json >> tribunal-workcell-proof.txt; ./bin/tribunal validate examples/product-decision.md --json >> tribunal-workcell-proof.txt; printf '# invalid docket
' > /tmp/invalid.md; if ./bin/tribunal validate /tmp/invalid.md --json >/tmp/invalid.out 2>&1; then exit 1; fi; printf 'failure-path-exit: nonzero
' >> tribunal-workcell-proof.txt; ./bin/tribunal review examples/product-decision.md --panel executioner-only --mock --storage-dir /tmp/tribunal-runs >> tribunal-workcell-proof.txt; test -f /tmp/tribunal-runs/*/record.json; printf 'happy-path: pass
' >> tribunal-workcell-proof.txt
